name: Dreamscape Escapade
source:
An urban slice-of-life visual novel centered around Lucius Amethio, a local photographer in his mid 20s, and the members of the street dance performer group known as the Trash Panda Stage.

[Edited from [url=https://dreamscape-escapades.itch.io/dreamscape-escapades]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一部都市生活片段视觉小说，以20多岁的当地摄影师卢修斯·阿米西奥 (Lucius Amethio) 和名为“垃圾熊猫舞台”(Trash Panda Stage) 的街舞表演团体的成员为中心。

[编辑自[url=https://dreamscape-escapades.itch.io/dreamscape-escapades]itch.io[/url]]
